verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a dedicated Scheduling Links feature that lets invitees pick a time from live availability and even auto-reshuffles lower-priority events to free up slots, directly matching the no-back-and-forth booking-link story (reclaim-docs-2, reclaim-docs-12, reclaim-docs-17, reclaim-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the booking-link flow (community evidence in the pack discusses other features like Habits/Calendar Sync, not scheduling links) and no detail on customization/branding of the link page.
